composition.name: Swiss Modular
composition.hierarchy: size + weight strictly on the module grid
composition.ground: white with hairline dividers, no containers
composition.dominantElement: the typographic headline seated on the grid

signature.text: All interactive elements share one hard offset shadow that shifts on press

composition.name: Ledger Grid
composition.scale: uniform small type, few size jumps
composition.density: high and even — tabular rows and columns
composition.hierarchy: flat with rank cues (position, weight), not size

signature.text: Every image is masked to the same irregular polygon derived from the logo

composition.name: Split Stage
composition.density: unbalanced by design — one pane packed, one calm
composition.hierarchy: the heavier pane leads; the split line is structural
composition.ground: two grounds in tension (tone, texture, or value)

signature.text: The accent color appears ONLY on the current nav item and the primary CTA — nowhere else

composition.name: Fractured Grid
composition.scale: colliding scales — fragments at different sizes
composition.hierarchy: the collision point leads; layers order the rest
composition.ground: layers overlap the ground and each other
composition.dominantElement: the collision point where layers meet

signature.text: A visible baseline ruler runs down one edge and content demonstrably sits on it

composition.name: Editorial Spread
composition.scale: oversized display type against modest body columns
composition.density: varied — columns, pull elements, deliberate gaps
composition.symmetry: magazine asymmetry; elements cross column boundaries
composition.hierarchy: display type first, decks and pulls second, body third
composition.ground: multi-column page the display type violates on purpose

signature.text: The layout grid becomes visible at exactly one moment (hover, load, or footer)
